About

Hey, I’m Issam. A computer science and AI student in Madrid, drawn to the space where technical curiosity meets creative work.

I like working across the stack: bringing AI into useful applications, exploring how systems behave under the hood, and making interactive things that feel a little different.

My interests span full-stack AI applications, low-level systems, and interactive graphics. I enjoy turning technical ideas into things people can use.

04

Game Dev

Sometimes the best way to explain how you think is to make something people can play. This little woodland is one of those experiments.

A world drawn in code

A custom Canvas 2D renderer, layered pixel scenery, and deterministic terrain. No game engine or runtime dependencies.

Small systems, real interaction

Time-based movement, collision boundaries, proximity interactions, and keyboard and touch controls.

Atmosphere by design

Warm light against a cold forest, animated rain, wandering fireflies, and an optional synthesized nighttime soundscape.

Play, at your own pace

Reduced-motion support, keyboard-accessible destinations, and an instant route to every portfolio section.

Beyond the woodland: Structural Atlas

An interactive molecular viewer written in C with SDL2. Explore 3D structures in wireframe and ball-and-stick modes, with rotation, panning, and zoom.
